column1: For a weak GPU, such as integrated graphics: it sets the 3D resolution to about 720 lines for the screen resolution you have now (66% at 1080p, 50% at 1440p, 33% at 4K; with Render resolution on Auto), keeps the HUD and the text sharp, and turns off bloom, depth of field, MSAA and FSR. The frame rate, shadows, FXAA, texture filtering and reverb stay as they are. Toaster, for the weakest: about 540 lines, 30 FPS, no shadows or FXAA, and cheaper texture filtering. You can change the 3D resolution, the frame rate, shadows and bloom afterwards.
column2: 面向较弱的 GPU（如核显）：按当前屏幕分辨率把 3D 分辨率设为约 720 线（1080p 为 66%，1440p 为 50%，4K 为 33%；渲染分辨率为自动时），保持 HUD 和文字清晰，并关闭泛光、景深、MSAA 和 FSR。帧率、阴影、FXAA、纹理过滤和混响保持不变。烤面包机，面向最弱的：约 540 线、30 FPS、无阴影和 FXAA，纹理过滤更省。之后可以再更改 3D 分辨率、帧率、阴影和泛光。

column1: The size of the 3D picture, in percent of the screen's. Lower is faster and softer; the HUD and the text stay sharp at full resolution. On a weak GPU this is what speeds the game up the most. Below 100%, the 3D models in the menus get no anti-aliasing.
column2: 3D 画面的大小，占屏幕的百分比。越低越快也越模糊；HUD 和文字以完整分辨率保持清晰。在较弱的 GPU 上，这是最能提速的设置。低于 100% 时，菜单中的 3D 模型没有抗锯齿。

column1: Rebuilds the 3D picture with FSR's temporal upscaling and anti-aliasing. FSR costs GPU time of its own: about 2 ms a frame on a fast graphics card, more on integrated graphics. For speed on a weak GPU, lower the 3D resolution or use Low-end mode instead.
column2: 用 FSR 的时间性超分辨率和抗锯齿重建 3D 画面。FSR 本身会占用 GPU 时间：在快的显卡上每帧约 2 ms，核显上更多。要在较弱的 GPU 上提速，请改为降低 3D 分辨率或使用低端模式。

column1: How small FSR draws the 3D picture before rebuilding it. Native AA draws it at full size: it only improves the image, and costs more than FSR off.
